messages:
nina: Heads-up: customer "AtlasHealth" on-prem report - ~37m gap in audit forwarding after RBAC cleanup this morning.

omar: Which RBAC change landed?

nina: `rbac/normalize-sas` merged at 05:03 UTC. It renamed `deploy-agent` -> `deploy-agent-min` and removed an old clusterrolebinding.

sylvie: Do we have forwarder pod logs?

nina: Snippet: 
```
2026-03-20T05:04:12 forwarder: open /var/log/kube-audit.log: permission denied
2026-03-20T05:04:18 forwarder: tailer exiting
```

alan: KMS agent shows principals mismatch: `access denied for key atlas-prod-kv (principal system:serviceaccount:atlas:deploy-agent)`

omar: Sounds like two failures: forwarder lost hostPath read, and KMS key ACLs still reference old SA name.

sylvie: Quick mitigation: recreate a minimal CRB that grants read-only on logs and `get` on relevant secrets for old SA name, so services resume. Then update KMS ACLs to include the new SA name before removing old principal.

nina: I applied an emergency CRB (deploy-agent-emergency-readonly) — forwarder resumed and backlog started shipping. KMS 403s reduced but `kv-sync` still hit 403 occasionally.

omar: Add `system:serviceaccount:atlas:deploy-agent-min` to `atlas-prod-kv` ACL temporarily, rotate the key with short TTL, then remove old principal.

sylvie: Post-incident actions: add CI preflight that checks RBAC changes against installer metadata (SA renames) and KMS principal mappings; add an automatic revert job for CRB deletes in the installer; and create an alert: KMS 403 rate >5% for 5m -> page sec-oncall.

inc-bot: Incident created: ONPREM-RBAC-KMS-1775012345. Severity P2. Actions assigned: nina (backfill), omar (KMS ACL + rotation), sylvie (CI preflight + runbook).

alan: For backfill use `rd-auditctl backfill --since 05:03 --src s3://atlas-audit/2026-03-20/ --dest splunk://collector:8088 --dry-run` then live run once ACLs rotated.

nina: Will coordinate with AtlasHealth compliance for postmortem and confirm retention/chain-of-custody for backfilled events. Closing loop after rotation and verification. :thumbsup:
